title: Test directory is readable from the agent sandbox
explanation: tests/ is bind-mounted read-only at /tests when the container starts, not copied in at verify time. Every task's expected outputs (and three literal expected_*.csv files) are one `cat` away from the policy. A policy that reads them is rewarded identically to one that solves the task.
suggested_patch: Remove the /tests mount from the agent service; copy tests/ into the verifier container only. Add a canary file under tests/ and fail the episode if it is read.

title: Reference solutions baked into the agent image
explanation: `COPY solution/ /opt/solution/` ships the oracle solve.sh for all 48 tasks into the image layer the agent runs in. The directory is not referenced by any task; it was left over from local debugging.
suggested_patch: Drop the COPY line and add solution/ to .dockerignore. Build the verifier image from a separate stage.

title: 7 tasks graded on a single hard-coded expected value
explanation: These tasks assert one literal (row count, checksum, first line). A policy that learns the literal passes without implementing the behaviour. Combined with LF-001 this is the cheapest hack available.
suggested_patch: Grade on a held-out input variant generated at verify time (shuffle rows, perturb timestamps) so the expected value cannot be memorised.

title: Unrestricted network egress from the agent container
explanation: `network = "bridge"` with no egress policy. Tasks do not require network access, but `pip install` and `curl` are available. This widens what the policy can learn from well beyond the task.
suggested_patch: Set `network = "none"` and pre-install the two packages tasks need in the image.

title: 3 tasks compare wall-clock timestamps in output
explanation: Expected output includes the generation time. Pass/fail flips depending on run duration, adding reward noise that masks real signal during RL.
suggested_patch: Freeze time in the verifier (`faketime` or monkeypatch `datetime.now`).
